hero.title: Our Story
hero.description: Discover the passion and craftsmanship behind every frozen delight. We're committed to creating the finest frozen desserts using only the freshest ingredients.

items.title: The Beginning
items.description: Started as a small family kitchen with a dream to create the perfect frozen dessert. Our first shop opened with just three flavors.

items.title: Expanding Our Horizons
items.description: Expanded to multiple locations across the city. Introduced seasonal flavors and gained recognition for our premium quality.

items.title: Innovation Award
items.description: Received the prestigious Innovation in Frozen Desserts award. Launched our signature collection of artisan ice creams.

items.title: Going Green
items.description: Transitioned to 100% sustainable packaging and sourced all dairy from local farms. Our commitment to the environment grew stronger.

items.title: Today
items.description: With over 50 locations nationwide, we continue to innovate and bring joy through our frozen creations. Every scoop tells a story.
